title: 第七章 生活微澜第八章 梦想第一步
content_zh:
第二天我如常上班。
公司距离家并不远，几百米的样子。
我在本地一家不大不小的家族式房地产公司做营销策划工作，这家公司皇亲国戚特别多，交织的利益和恩怨甚多，很容易就顺得哥情失嫂意，不过我在这公司差不多七八年了，和我一起进来的都走了，我坚持没走的原因，一是老板待我不薄，相对而言，工作也较为轻松；二是距离父母近，自己出来工作后在外面跑了十年了，像棵蒲公英般的到处游走，现在能回到父母身边，随时可以回去看看他们，这不是工资高就能替代的，虽然上一份工作的待遇比现在要好上一倍，但也还是义无反顾的回到这个特大城市辖区内最偏远最落后的区里工作了。
对于我这个非公司老板家族族群的员工来说，策划的存在，更是一份冰与火两重天的工作，房地产大环境形势一片大好的时候，老板会觉得这是形势大好的原因，放只猪在策划位置也能将房子以好价钱卖出去；房地产大环境形势收到政策挤压或者银行限贷的时候，老板又会觉得房子卖不出去是因为策划的方案和销售的水平不给力的原因。
在房地产公司做策划很难，在家族式房地产公司上班更难，在家族式房地产公司上班做策划更是难上加难。
总而言之，策划这份工作，在我国的任何行业里都不是一份能让方方面面满意的工作。
若不是小老板强烈要求，这间从建筑工程公司转型而来的本地家族式房地产公司永远不会有策划这个职位存在的。
小老板在外国留学回来，开始是充满了理想主义情怀的，按照现代公司的模式进行管理，开始各个部门也是尽心尽力的去执行，可慢慢的就变了味道，那些跟着老板十几二十年的老员工怎么适应每天准时打卡上下班、各项工作要有记录和跟进，这些自由惯了老臣们，纷纷开始了各种花式的懈怠，一旦用制度抓紧了堵住了漏洞，发工资的时候被扣疼得捂住牙帮子的时候，便以老臣的身份去向老板告御状，说什么不够人性化，做得多反而扣得多，销售部的不到二十岁的男男女女们却个个月两三万的工资。
然后便频频出现了老板和小老板之间的执拗较劲，姜还是老的辣，老板说除了销售和策划之外，公司其他部门的小老板就不要管了。
小老板一生气，像闲云野鹤般神隐，爱来公司的时候半夜也来，不来公司就什么时候都不来，就连相关部门过来检查工作的时候也绝对不出现。
小老板对上一次和老板发脾气摔门而出之后对我说：“林凡，销售策划工作你一手抓，你的职位是我设置的，招聘你也是我亲自拍板的，你有什么就告诉我，我爸那里你听听就好了。
我对你这里还是有期望的。”
我说：“你一不管，老板可是要卡我脖子的。
何况你这么要求，同样的事情我要汇报两次，我累呀！”
其实老板不是那个和小老板拼了老命都要较劲的主儿，也是很好人很平易近人的一个普通老头儿，只是天下的父子都差不离这样的状态，虽然没有隔夜仇，但是却在小事情的大是大非上整天势成水火，如果不知道是两父子的话，还以为老家伙倚老卖老欺负少年郎或是少年郎年少气盛欺负N旬老翁呢！
记得我进来应聘的时候，小老板对我的业务能力和视野很满意，就要在合同上签名盖章的时候，老板突然就出现了，说要等等。
老板当着小老板的面问我：“你的属相是什么？”
我有点不明所以，说了我出生的梗之后，老板说：“哦，那你属羊不是属猴，属相看农历的。”
然后掐指在算了算，“你的属相和我儿子很合得来。
没问题，合同现在签就签吧！”

小老板便签名嘴上便叨叨：“我留学回来的，你和我说属相相冲相克。
那还不如再问问林凡的星座是不是合得来！”
老板说：“好像留学回来就好巴闭的样子，怎么都是中国人啊！
中国人不讲属相讲什么？我告诉你，属相不配的人在一起做不好什么事情的。”
小老板说：“又不是谈恋爱。
哎，林凡你什么星座啊？”
我说：“摩羯座啊！
我如果和金牛座的一起就很合得来，星座学说上面这么说的。”
小老板签名的手停了下来，侧头看着我，一脸的皱褶：“你知道我是什么星座的？”
我呵呵一笑：“让我掐指算算咯！
哦，你的表情出卖了你，你是金牛的对吧？”
老板和小老板同时看着我，我楞了一下，觉得这两父子还是挺开明的，心里盘算了一秒钟，便决定开个玩笑：“你们两父子别看着我啊！
我的属相老板您满意，我的星座小老板您满意，皆大欢喜的事。
哎，赶紧签名盖章啊！
我明天要来上班了，不然后天家里揭不开锅了。”
在招聘的现场开老板玩笑，真有点飞跃悬崖之感，分寸把握不好，跃不过对面，那就崖底见了，杨过有能力爬上来，我林凡就算杨过给个大雕让我骑，我也上不来了。
content_en:
I went to work as usual the next day.
The company is not far from home, just a few hundred meters.
I work as a marketing planner in a local real estate company that is not too big or too small. There are many royal family members in this company, and there are many intertwined interests and grievances. It is easy to be in love with your brother or your sister-in-law. However, I have been in this company for almost seven or eight years, and everyone who came with me has left. The reason why I insist on not leaving is that the boss treats me well, and the work is relatively easy; It's because I'm close to my parents. I've been running around outside for ten years since I started working, wandering around like a dandelion. Now I can return to my parents and I can go back and visit them at any time. This cannot be replaced by high wages. Although the salary of the last job is twice as good as now, I still have no hesitation in returning to work in the most remote and backward district within the jurisdiction of this megacity.
For me, an employee who is not a member of the company owner’s family, planning is a job that is as good as ice and fire. When the real estate environment is good, the boss will think that this is the reason for the good situation. Putting a pig in the planning position can sell the house at a good price; when the real estate environment is squeezed by policies or banks restrict lending, the boss will think that the reason why the house cannot be sold is because the planning plan and sales level are not strong.
It is difficult to do planning in a real estate company, it is even harder to work in a family-owned real estate company, and it is even more difficult to do planning in a family-owned real estate company.
All in all, planning is not a job that satisfies everyone in any industry in our country.
If it weren't for the strong request of the small boss, this local family-owned real estate company that transformed from a construction engineering company would never have a planning position.
When the young boss came back from studying abroad, he was full of idealism at first. He managed according to the modern company model. At first, each department tried its best to implement it, but slowly it changed. How can those old employees who have been with the boss for more than ten or twenty years adapt to clocking in and getting off work on time every day, and recording and following up on all work? These freedoms The veterans who got used to it began to slack off in various ways. Once the system was tightened and the loopholes were plugged, and when the wages were deducted and they covered their teeth in pain, they would complain to the boss as veterans, saying that they were not humane enough and that the more they did, the more they deducted. The men and women in the sales department who were less than 20 years old were paid 20,000 to 30,000 yuan a month.
Then there were frequent stubborn rivalries between the boss and the junior bosses. The old boss was still the boss. The boss said that except for sales and planning, the junior bosses in other departments of the company should be left alone.
When the little boss is angry, he disappears like a wandering crane. He comes to the company in the middle of the night when he likes to come to the company. If he doesn't come to the company, he won't come at any time. He will never show up even when the relevant departments come to inspect the work.
The little boss said to me after he lost his temper with his boss last time and slammed the door: "Lin Fan, you handle the sales planning work by yourself. I set your position and I personally made the decision to recruit you. If you have anything, just tell me. Just listen to my dad."
I still have expectations for you. "
I said, "If you don't care, the boss will strangle me."
What's more, if you ask me to do so, I have to report the same thing twice. I'm tired! "
In fact, the boss is not the boss who has been fighting with the little boss for his whole life. He is also an ordinary old man who is very nice and approachable. But all fathers and sons in the world are in the same state. Although there is no overnight feud, they are at loggerheads all day long over trivial matters. If you didn't know it was the father and son, you would have thought that the old guy was relying on his old age to bully the young man, or the young man was bullying the ten-year-old man in his youth!
I remember when I applied for a job, my boss was very impressed by my business ability and vision.Ye was very satisfied and was about to sign and seal the contract when the boss suddenly appeared and said he would have to wait.
The boss asked me in front of the little boss: "What is your zodiac sign?"
I was a little confused. After telling me about my birth date, the boss said: "Oh, then you are a sheep and not a monkey. Your zodiac sign is based on the lunar calendar."
Then he pinched his fingers and calculated, "Your zodiac sign matches my son very well.
No problem, sign the contract now! "
The little boss signed his name and kept saying: "I came back from studying abroad, and you told me that the zodiac signs conflict with each other.
Then it would be better to ask Lin Fan if his zodiac signs are compatible! "
The boss said: "It seems like I just shut up after studying abroad. Why are they all Chinese!"
What do Chinese people talk about if they don’t talk about zodiac signs? Let me tell you, people who don't match each other can't do anything together. "
The little boss said: "It's not about falling in love.
Hey, Lin Fan, what's your zodiac sign? "
I said: "Capricorn!
If I are with a Taurus, I will be very compatible. This is what the zodiac theory says. "
The little boss stopped signing with his hand and looked sideways at me with a wrinkled face: "Do you know what zodiac sign I am?"
I chuckled: "Let me count with my fingers!
Oh, your expression betrays you, you are a Taurus, right? "
The boss and the little boss looked at me at the same time. I was stunned for a moment and thought that these two father and son were quite open-minded. I thought about it for a second and then decided to make a joke: "You two, father and son, don't look at me!
You are satisfied with my zodiac sign boss, you are satisfied with my zodiac sign boss, everyone is happy.
Hey, hurry up and sign and seal it!
I have to come to work tomorrow, otherwise there won’t be any trouble at home the next day. "
Making fun of the boss at the recruitment site feels a bit like leaping over a cliff. If you don't grasp the timing well and can't jump to the other side, you'll end up at the bottom of the cliff. Yang Guo has the ability to climb up. I, Lin Fan, even if Yang Guo gives me a big eagle to ride on, I won't be able to get up.
